provider: Vercel Deployment Storage / artifact store (Hobby, 30-day TTL)

free_tier.stated: 10 GB of Deployment Storage per Hobby team, and that pool is what every retained deployment output draws from. This is the clearest example in the whole slot of a 'free tier' that is a build-artifact store, not storage.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Deployment Retention defaults for Hobby are now 30 days for ALL four states. Canceled, errored, pre-production, production (Pro gets 180 days preview / 1 year production).

egress.terms: Served by Vercel's CDN at no separate charge while the deployment exists (Fast Data Transfer Hobby allowance is 100 GB, shared across all Vercel services). Deployment URLs are public unless Deployment Protection is on.

tooling: `vercel deploy` CLI / Git integration / REST Deployments API. No object-level API at all. You cannot address a file inside a deployment except by URL. No rclone backend and no possible wrapper, because there is no list/put primitive.
chaining: None useful. 10 GB is a hard pool shared by every project on the team, and going over it 'can block you from deploying until you free some up'. 200 projects on Hobby but one shared 10 GB. The multiplier actively works against you here.

limits.value: Retention defaults for Hobby are now 30 days
review deployments no longer get their own protection

limits_note: THE TTL IS THE STORY, and it tightened twice in 2026. Deployment Retention defaults for Hobby are now 30 days for ALL four states. Canceled, errored, pre-production, production (Pro gets 180 days preview / 1 year production). The Sept 16, 2026 changelog cut it further: 'Each Hobby project now keeps its 3 most recent production deployments, plus its 3 most recent deployments of any type, regardless of age. Preview deployments no longer get their own protection.' Deletion runs within 48 hours of eligibility, then a recovery window, then permanent removal. CLI source upload is capped at 100 MB per deploy (Hobby), 15,000 files.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Hard, automatic, irreversible expiry after 30 days. Any file hosted only in a deployment URL is gone a month later. Treat as a 30-day hot tier and nothing else.
